anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After moves f1 from fails to holds as intended: Snapshot 1 now carries an explicit `exit: obstacle - undispositionable BLOCKED, course unset`, withholds merge (`Not offered: merge (blocked by GitHub)`), offers numeric `deliver` as a continuation rather than an ordinary wait row, and Snapshot 2 is a clearly separate readiness menu where the final selection (merge/approve/stop) is made. Before failed f1 because its first menu was an ordinary wait menu (`1. wait - run one bounded CI watch`) with approve recommended and no obstacle exit or deliver course. Nothing Before kept was lost: Snapshot 2 still reports `source: ci - CI-sufficient row` with the refreshed `e2e success` (f3), still offers merge on the unchanged head 9c1e4f2 (f2), and states `merge state: MERGEABLE, CLEAN` with no residual BLOCKED language (f4). The current After wording already satisfies every fact; the only cosmetic suggestion is to keep the Snapshot 1 PR-comment list consistent with the obstacle framing (the `e2e check is still running` line is fine, but ensure it never reads as a wait prompt), and to keep the `exit: readiness` line in Snapshot 2 so the separation from the obstacle continuation stays explicit.
